title: Diptych with Targets and Planes
description: Two framed collages presented as a diptych, each densely layered with paper fragments, target rings, and warplane silhouettes on crumpled white grounds. Yellow horizontal bands, magenta accents, chess pieces, and perforated dots recur across both panels, unifying the composition.
